description: The pie chart represents the distribution of categories in a dataset, comparing the proportions of different categories. The chart is divided into seven slices, representing the categories Math, Coding, Information Seeking, Reasoning, Planning, Creative Writing, and Others (combined). The slices are labeled with their corresponding category names and percentages, and are colored red (Math, 29.3%), blue (Coding, 24.3%), light green (Information Seeking, 22.2%), orange (Reasoning, 10.4%), pale green (Others, 9.3%), purple (Planning, 2.3%), and pink (Creative Writing, 2.2%). A legend is provided to the top left of the chart, listing the categories and their corresponding colors, as well as numerical values for each category. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest slice (Math) at the top left and the smallest slices (Planning and Creative Writing) at the top right. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular slice.
